manuscript.bias_activation_wording: ReLU is employed throughout the network; the text does not separately resolve an output activation
manuscript.loss_figure_caption: mean position loss for the bias curve

released_implementation.bias_output_units: metres, established by direct subtraction from metre-valued pseudorange residuals
released_implementation.normalization: NumPy population mean/std over all valid KLT3 feature rows; constructed as float32 tensors then converted to float64 with the model
released_implementation.normalization_population_identity_with_w: exact same source loop and population; independently recomputed shared cache values match
released_implementation.ground_truth_loading: skip 30 header rows and 4 footer rows; add 18 seconds; nearest timestamp; DMS to decimal degrees
released_implementation.ground_truth_training_defect: bias trainer appends each successful epoch GT twice, so training epoch i reads KLT3 GT row floor(i/2); prediction aligns GT once per epoch
released_implementation.model_initialization: PyTorch Linear defaults in float32, then entire model converted to float64
released_implementation.batch_behavior: unused; loss is accumulated over the full KLT3 sequence and exactly one optimizer step occurs per training epoch
released_implementation.executed_loss: sum of per-epoch 3D ENU Euclidean position-error norms
released_implementation.bias_sign: positive b subtracts metres: solve residual is (P - predicted_observation) - b
released_implementation.torch_observation_defect: H_matrix_prl_torch passes an allocated but unpopulated LOS vector to satazel, yielding zero atmospheric corrections; preserved
released_implementation.prediction_mode: net.eval() but no torch.no_grad() in upstream; controlled evaluation adds no_grad without changing values
released_implementation.prediction_outputs: one result-path/b/<epoch>.csv with time,sat,bias; gt.csv; TDL_bias_pos.csv; console arithmetic mean 2D and 3D ENU norms
released_implementation.testing_and_plotting_scripts: bias_network_predict.py performs TDL-B inference; baseline.py computes goGPS/RTKLIB; plot_result.py consumes saved method trajectories for held-out error/trajectory plots and does not create training-loss curves
released_implementation.training_plot: vis_loss stores the raw full-dataset sum; loss.png plots that raw sum; console prints sum/len(obss)
released_implementation.composite_paper_figure_logic: not present in dd5eac6; no released script establishes how the manuscript's combined mean-loss figure was assembled

tracked_checkpoint_inconsistency.content: state_dict for the different BiasNet class with BatchNorm and output de-standardization
